'''Hanugar''' was an older [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who, along with several other members of his [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] crew, worked to dupe two [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] into helping them find the treasure of [[Zelosian's Chine]]. He and [[Sevik (criminal)|Sevik]] were shipwrecked when their ship ran into one of [[Zelos II]]'s many corals reefs where Sevik and Hanugar were forced to fight off [[melk]] and wait for co-conspirator [[K'zk]]. After finding the treasure, the ship crew left the Weequays for dead, only to have the Weequays swear that they would hunt them down.<ref name="Day of the Sepulchral Night" />
